title: Cricket data
description: Cricket players, teams and stats, explorable with Datasette.

players.description: Men's and women's international players. Full-text search available on names.

teams.description: International and domestic teams. Full-text search available on names.

formats.description: Formats of the game (Tests, ODIs, T20Is) referenced by stats.classId.

stats.description: International career stats by player and format.

styles.description: ESPNcricinfo batting and bowling style codes and their labels. players stores the labels.

player_stats.description: Career stats by player and format, joined with the player's country, styles and role. Search matches player names.

career_totals.description: Each player's international career summed across Tests, ODIs and T20Is. Search matches player names.

most_runs.title: Most runs
most_runs.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all.
most_runs.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bat_matches, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_hundreds, bat_fifties from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) order by bat_runs desc limit 100

most_wickets.title: Most wickets
most_wickets.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all.
most_wickets.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bowl_matches, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy, bowl_fiveWickets from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) order by bowl_wickets desc limit 100

highest_scores.title: Highest individual scores
highest_scores.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all.
highest_scores.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bat_highScore, bat_matches, bat_runs from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bat_highScoreRuns is not null order by bat_highScoreRuns desc, bat_highScoreNotOut desc limit 100

best_bowling_figures.title: Best bowling figures in an innings
best_bowling_figures.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all.
best_bowling_figures.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bowl_bestInnings, bowl_bestMatch, bowl_wickets from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bowl_bestInningsWickets is not null order by bowl_bestInningsWickets desc, bowl_bestInningsRuns asc limit 100

best_batting_average.title: Best batting average
best_batting_average.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all. min_innings: e.g. 20.
best_batting_average.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bat_innings, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_hundreds from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bat_innings >= cast(:min_innings as integer) order by bat_average desc limit 100

best_bowling_average.title: Best bowling average
best_bowling_average.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all. min_wickets: e.g. 50.
best_bowling_average.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bowl_matches, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bowl_wickets >= cast(:min_wickets as integer) order by bowl_average asc limit 100

best_strike_rate.title: Best batting strike rate
best_strike_rate.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all. min_balls: e.g. 500. Older Tests lack balls faced.
best_strike_rate.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bat_innings, bat_balls, bat_runs, bat_strikeRate, bat_sixes from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bat_balls >= cast(:min_balls as integer) order by bat_strikeRate desc limit 100

most_five_wicket_hauls.title: Most 5-wicket hauls
most_five_wicket_hauls.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all.
most_five_wicket_hauls.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bowl_matches, bowl_wickets, bowl_fiveWickets, bowl_tenWickets, bowl_bestInnings from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bowl_fiveWickets > 0 order by bowl_fiveWickets desc, bowl_wickets desc limit 100

allrounders.title: All-rounders
allrounders.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all. min_runs and min_wickets: e.g. 1000 and 50. Sorted by batting minus bowling average.
allrounders.sql: select longName, country, format, gender, bat_matches, bat_runs, bat_average, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, round(bat_average - bowl_average, 2) as averageDifference from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and bat_runs >= cast(:min_runs as integer) and bowl_wickets >= cast(:min_wickets as integer) order by averageDifference desc limit 100

player_profile.title: Player profile
player_profile.description: name: any part of the player's name, e.g. Kohli.
player_profile.sql: select longName, country, format, bat_matches, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_highScore, bat_hundreds, bat_fifties, bat_strikeRate, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy, bowl_bestInnings, bat_catches, bat_stumpings from player_stats where longName like '%' || :name || '%' order by longName, classId limit 100

compare_players.title: Compare two players
compare_players.description: player_a and player_b: any part of each name, e.g. Tendulkar and Ponting. format: Tests, ODIs, T20Is or blank.
compare_players.sql: select longName, country, format, bat_matches, bat_runs, bat_average, bat_strikeRate, bat_hundreds, bowl_wickets, bowl_average, bowl_economy from player_stats where (longName like '%' || :player_a || '%' or longName like '%' || :player_b || '%') and (:format = '' or format = :format) order by format, longName limit 100

youngest_players.title: Youngest players
youngest_players.description: gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave blank for all.
youngest_players.sql: select p.longName, c.name as country, p.gender, p.dateOfBirth, p.playingRoles from players p left join countries c on c.id = p.countryId where p.hasStats and p.dateOfBirth is not null and (:gender = '' or p.gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or c.name = :country) order by p.dateOfBirth desc limit 100

oldest_players.title: Oldest players
oldest_players.description: gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave blank for all.
oldest_players.sql: select p.longName, c.name as country, p.gender, p.dateOfBirth, p.playingRoles from players p left join countries c on c.id = p.countryId where p.hasStats and p.dateOfBirth is not null and (:gender = '' or p.gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or c.name = :country) order by p.dateOfBirth asc limit 100

batting_hand_split.title: Left-handers vs right-handers
batting_hand_split.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. country: e.g. India. Leave any blank for all. min_innings: e.g. 20.
batting_hand_split.sql: select battingStyles, count(*) as players, sum(bat_runs) as runs, sum(bat_hundreds) as hundreds, round(1.0 * sum(bat_runs) / nullif(sum(bat_innings) - sum(bat_notOuts), 0), 2) as average, round(100.0 * sum(bat_runs) / nullif(sum(bat_balls), 0), 2) as strikeRate from player_stats where (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) and (:country = '' or country = :country) and battingStyles is not null and bat_innings >= cast(:min_innings as integer) group by battingStyles order by average desc

country_summary.title: Country summary
country_summary.description: format: Tests, ODIs or T20Is. gender: M or F. Leave blank for all.
country_summary.sql: select country, count(distinct playerId) as players, sum(bat_runs) as runs, sum(bat_hundreds) as hundreds, sum(bowl_wickets) as wickets, sum(bowl_fiveWickets) as fiveWicketHauls from player_stats where country is not null and (:format = '' or format = :format) and (:gender = '' or gender = :gender) group by country order by runs desc
